verdict.rationale: The published SOSPortal page states up front that the service is available 24/7, which settles the operating-hours window. The evidence says nothing about per-day filing or search limits, or about any session timeout on the online filing flow. Missing for 10: published per-day limits (or a statement that there are none), published session-timeout behavior (e.g., draft auto-save on timeout), and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
